latest_release.name: T3 Code v0.1.9
latest_release.body:
**v0.1.9** · 198 changes from 31 contributors

- **T3 Connect agent sign-in.** Approve agent sign-ins with T3 Connect instead of copying a pairing code.
- **Send during uploads.** Send messages with attachments while they are still uploading.
- **Claude session approvals.** Allow an MCP app for a Claude session instead of approving each action individually.
- **Screen reader announcements.** Hear agent messages and steps during a turn without leaving the composer.
- **GitLab revert.** Revert a merged GitLab merge request from T3 Code.
- **OpenCode goals.** Use OpenCode's native goals and keep their state in sync across clients.
- **Pull request links.** Open pull request links directly to their referenced comment, diff line, checks, or commit.

### Plus 164 more bug fixes and performance improvements.

<details>
<summary>Full changelog</summary>

## What's Changed
* fix(web): checking for updates finds provider updates on every machine by @t3dotgg in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33538
* fix(web): settings say custom instructions cover pull request descriptions by @maria-rcks in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33113
* feat(web): send messages while attachments upload by @maria-rcks in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33092
* fix(mobile): Android PDF preview double-tap zoom and easier link taps by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33570
* feat: approve agent sign-ins with T3 Connect instead of a code by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33600
* fix(mobile): the composer and search bars move with their iOS columns by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33543
* ci(mobile): build Android store releases on Blacksmith by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33565
* fix(web): thread title menu opens without a half-second wait on desktop by @t3dotgg in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33598
* fix(web): a new side chat focuses its message input by @darioielardi in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/32929
* perf(opencode): bound usage reads to in-window messages by @Yash-Singh1 in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33612
* chore(web): upgrade @pierre/diffs to 1.7 and use its built-in find by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33627
* fix(web): expanding hidden diff context works after a diff refresh by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33629
* feat: approve agent sign-ins on app.t3.codes with T3 Connect by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33632
* perf(cursor): improve account usage scanning by @Yash-Singh1 in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33636
* fix(web): dropdown items over the desktop title bar respond to clicks by @screen-gd in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/32643
* fix: hosted agent approval no longer fails with "Your session cannot approve" by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33645
* fix(web): new threads use the last used project by @Yash-Singh1 in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33626
* fix(mobile): distinguish local ACP instances by name by @shivamhwp in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/32467
* ci(mobile): dev clients build on Blacksmith, and mobile:install starts that build by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33617
* fix(mobile): Android sidebar and composer transitions no longer reflow at rest by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33599
* fix(server): price Antigravity Gemini Flash effort variants by @Ephraim-9 in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/13809
* fix(mobile): Android feed stays at its end after the keyboard or sidebar changes by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/33611
* fix(server): Antigravity install no longer fails on a stale Windows Crashpad pipe by @juliusmarminge in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/26374
* ci(mobile): Android PR previe
